candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition to always revert, making transfer always fail instead of returning true.
Delete the require statement checking _tos.length > 0, so transfer can be called with empty arrays and return true without making any external calls.
Replace the low-level call with a delegatecall, changing the execution context so that storage changes happen in C instead of caddress.
Replace 'for(uint i=0;i<_tos.length;i++)' with 'for(uint i=0;i<v.length;i++)', making the loop bound depend on v.length instead of _tos.length.
Replace 'return true' with 'return false', altering the boolean result observable by the caller.
